name: TikTok Shop
citation: TikTok Shop Seller University: return and refund policy

facts.text: Customers have 30 calendar days from the date the package is marked as Delivered to submit a return and refund request, unless a different return window is specified at checkout.
facts.quote: Customers have the return timeframe specified at checkout or the default 30 calendar days from the date the package is marked as "Delivered" to submit a return and refund request.

facts.text: Sellers are responsible for return shipping costs when the return reason is seller-fault (e.g., product quality issues or packaging damage).
facts.quote: If at least 1 item in a batch is being returned due to a seller-fault reason, the seller is responsible for the return shipping fee.

facts.text: Sellers bear the cost of shipping item replacements or exchanges from seller to customer; TikTok Shop covers return shipping costs for exchanges.
facts.quote: The seller will bear the cost of shipping the item replacement from the seller to the customer and the cost of return shipping of the original item.

facts.text: Sellers must state their return policy clearly, including return windows and conditions, and comply with TikTok Shop's policies and applicable laws.
facts.quote: This policy is updated periodically. Sellers must check this page regularly to ensure compliance with our current policy.
